model: danger_model2 recipe refit on all dated notices (danger_apply.py), inputs national_v5_out + hazard_nat_v2 + aux_s1 + exposure cues
coverage: blocks south of 56N, every chart-safe cell within 6 km of a sounding (no route filter); inland lakes excluded
rule: notice eligible iff id > cutoff_id and date > sealed; inside iff a scored cell within 1 km; hit iff nearest cell percentile >= 90 (chance 10%) / >= 99 (chance 1%)
